name: Kimi to Tawai mo Nai Oshaberi o
original_name: きみとたわいもないおしゃべりを
source:
When a girl suddenly finds herself lost in an unknown world, Silk saves her from getting involved with unsavory people.

This incredibly kind-hearted and caring boy is, for some reason, shunned by the townsfolk.

An isekai otome game in which the protagonist has conversations with Silk, a quiet and gentle boy.

[Translated from [url=https://core-about.com/works/kimitawa/]official website[/url]]
translation:
当一个女孩突然发现自己迷失在一个未知的世界时，西尔克救了她，让她免于与讨厌的人交往。

这个令人难以置信的善良和关怀的男孩，由于某种原因，被镇上的人们避开。

主角与安静温柔的男孩Silk对话的异世界乙女游戏。

[翻译自[url=https://core-about.com/works/kimitawa/]官网[/url]]
